name: ANSI/IEEE wound-rotor induction motor symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for wound-rotor induction motor, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The wound-rotor motor form identifies a machine with a separately documented rotor circuit. The rotor connections and associated control or starting equipment remain distinct from the stator's three-phase supply.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace stator and rotor circuits independently.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A wound-rotor machine differs electrically from a cage-rotor motor without accessible rotor terminals.
